profile.headline: Senior Software Developer / Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
- 25+ years of experience across the full web and enterprise development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and analysis through design, development, testing, deployment, and post‑production support.
- Design and implementation of integration solutions across platforms and technologies, ensuring reliable communication between heterogeneous systems.
- Coordination of development teams using diverse methodologies, defining software architectures, standards, and conventions that improved delivery quality and consistency.
- Serve as a Java programming instructor, mentoring developers and strengthening engineering best practices across teams.
- Prepare structured training sessions and comprehensive documentation (Wiki, Confluence) to support onboarding, knowledge sharing, and continuous skill development for engineering teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Designed, enhanced, and delivered RESTful APIs using Java 8, Spring Boot, Oracle, Gradle, Jenkins, PCF, Sonar, Splunk, and IntelliJ, implementing key improvements that optimized checkout‑transaction processing across the payment ecosystem.
- Collaborated closely with Product Owners and Service Architects to design secure, scalable technical solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer @Mastercard
positions.description:
- Led Agile development iterations for payment‑network initiatives, managing a cross‑functional team and coordinating delivery cycles using Rally to ensure alignment, transparency, and on‑time execution.
- Designed, enhanced, and delivered RESTful APIs using Java 8, Spring Boot, Oracle, Gradle, Jenkins, PCF, Sonar, Splunk, and IntelliJ, implementing key improvements that enabled advanced card‑management functionality and optimized checkout‑transaction processing across the payment ecosystem.
- Collaborated closely with Product Owners and Service Architects to design secure, scalable technical solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements.
- Provided advanced support to application consumers, resolving complex issues across environments and ensuring continuity of service.
- Created clear, comprehensive technical documentation in Confluence and delivered structured KT sessions to onboard new team members and support continuous learning.
- Supported the migration of millions of data entries across regional data centers, ensuring accuracy, integrity, and minimal disruption to business operations.
- Modernized downstream communication by migrating integrations from ESB to a customized Spring Security implementation, improving performance, maintainability, and system interoperability.

positions.title: Senior Java Engineer @Mastercard
positions.description:
- Managed Agile development iterations using Rally, coordinating a cross‑functional team to deliver high‑quality features for payment network initiatives while maintaining alignment with business priorities.
- Designed, enhanced, and delivered RESTful APIs using Java 8, Spring Boot, Oracle, Gradle, Jenkins, PCF, Sonar, Splunk, and IntelliJ to enable seamless integration across payment network business operations, supporting transaction processing, partner connectivity, and card management functionality.
- Refactored RESTful APIs with Java 8, Spring Boot, Maven, Docker, and IntelliJ to enhance integration across the payment network, optimizing tokenization flows and improving reliability for upstream consumers.
- Partnered with Product Owners and Service Architects to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions.
- Provided advanced support to application consumers, troubleshooting complex issues across environments and ensuring continuity of service.
- Created clear, comprehensive technical documentation in Confluence and delivered structured KT sessions to onboard new team members and strengthen ongoing team capability.

positions.title: Technology Lead @UBS
positions.description:
- Led the enhancement of a Java-based financial portal, ensuring regulatory compliance, functional accuracy, and long-term maintainability through modular design, documentation, and shared Java libraries, using tools like Java, JSP, Spring Framework, Maven, WebSphere, DB2, IntelliJ, Eclipse, Autosys, Jenkins, SonarQube, Git.
- Integrated secure RESTful APIs using Apigee, modernized backend infrastructure, and contributed to microservices migration—enhancing interoperability, scalability, and system resilience, using tools like Java, REST API, Apigee, Linux, Jenkins, Spring Security, Maven, IBM MQ.
- Improved backend performance and maintainability by refactoring code to meet Java code standards, reducing technical debt and aligning enterprise-grade security benchmarks, using tools like SonarQube.
- Coordinated cross-regional development teams, coordinated Agile sprints and ensured timely, high-quality software delivery aligned with business goals, using tools like JIRA, Microsoft Project.
- Promoted a culture of continuous learning by mentoring developers, delivering architectural guidance, and building structured knowledge assets—such as internal wikis and transfer sessions—to empower distributed teams, using tools like Confluence, KT Sessions.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · ADF/JSF/Struts/JSP · Sonarqube · DB2 · Maven · WebSphere MQ · Confluence · Jira · Microsoft Project · Linux · Jenkins · Leadership · Gitlab

positions.title: Freelancer Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the design, development, and deployment of enterprise‑grade RESTful  web services that modernized an insurance broker’s billing and content‑management platforms, using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, WildFly, Gradle, and related technologies.
- Delivered scalable digital solutions across multiple industries—building REST services and lightweight applications for auctions, stock exchange, and marketing companies—supporting their digital transformation initiatives.
- Developed a wide range of customer‑facing and internal web applications, including content‑managed corporate sites, surveys, promotions, loan calculators, intranets, online courses, transportation systems, and academic grading systems using PHP, ASP/ASP.NET, MySQL, SQL Server, Apache, IIS, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS.
- Assisted in configuring the full IT platform for a major insurance web application, including Linux servers, WildFly deployments, PostgreSQL integration, Jenkins pipelines, Maven builds, and shell‑script automation to strengthen production monitoring and reliability.
- Participated in migrating thousands of documents into the enterprise content manager using Java and REST services, improving document centralization, accessibility, and long‑term governance.
- Led a month‑long Basic Java Core training for 250+ adult learners at CETEC Ecuador, elevating their programming capabilities and positioning them for stronger job prospects and career advancement.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Java · Linux · ASP.NET · MySQL · PostgreSQL · Apache · WildFly · jQuery · HTML5/CSS3/Boostrap/XML · Microsoft SQL Server · Leadership

positions.title: Digital Channels Manager
positions.description:
- Contributed to the development of client‑facing portals that enabled users to manage customer accounts, refunds, and insurance policy details, strengthening digital service delivery and user experience.
- Supported the management and delivery of web application projects for supplier and customer self‑management using Java, Struts, JSP, JBoss, SOAP web services, Oracle, and SVN, working in partnership with business departments, the IT team, and external software vendors.
- Participated in establishing coding standards, architectural guidelines, version control structures, and integration practices, contributing to a more consistent and scalable development environment.
- Helped implement an organized methodology for handling business web requests, improving prioritization, communication, and traceability across departments.
- Collaborated with internal teams and third‑party providers to configure the IT platform for the main client portal, including JBoss standalone setup on Oracle Linux and the development of tools for deployments and log maintenance.
- Helped design and structure the internal documentation framework (“Wikipedia”) for web applications, improving consistency, knowledge sharing, and the sustainability of ongoing operations.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Java · JBoss Application Server · SOAP Web Services · Oracle · Oracle Reports · Microsoft Project · Project Planning · Git/Subversion

positions.title: Project Specialist
positions.description:
- Supported the development of enterprise self‑management platforms for customers, suppliers, and brokers using Java, Spring, Struts, JSP, SOAP web services, Oracle, SVN, JSF, Oracle Service Bus, WebLogic, and Oracle Application Server.
- Contributed to defining version control practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines that improved consistency and scalability across projects.
- Worked closely with the external software factory and internal teams to design integration solutions across different technologies, ensuring smooth interoperability.
- Participated in the design of Oracle database models—tables, views, stored procedures, UDTs, and functions—to support complex insurance processes.
- Helped structure the internal documentation “Wikipedia” for web applications, improving knowledge sharing and onboarding efficiency.
- Contributed to the development and publication of Java SOAP web services on Oracle Service Bus, playing a key role in the company’s early SOA transformation.
- Supported the creation of Java libraries that enhanced core insurance operations and improved system reliability.

positions.title: System Specialist
positions.description:
- Built and enhanced enterprise self‑management platforms for customers, suppliers, and brokers using Java, Spring, Struts, JSP, SOAP web services, Oracle, SVN, Oracle Application Server, and Ant, enabling smoother digital interactions across the insurance ecosystem.
- Engineered comprehensive Oracle database components—tables, views, stored procedures, UDTs, and functions—to support business rules, reporting, and mission‑critical processes.
- Developed several web applications tailored to the operational needs of insurance brokers, improving service quality and operational responsiveness.
- Strengthened platform stability and scalability through best practices in backend development, integration, and database design.
- Supported digital transformation initiatives by delivering robust, maintainable, and user‑centered web solutions.

positions.title: Consultant I
positions.description:
- Built and optimized PL/SQL components—including stored procedures, UDTs, and functions—to support high‑volume telecommunications operations.
- Led the end‑to‑end development and publication of Java/Struts/JSP web applications, integrating SOAP web services and deploying solutions on Oracle Application Server.
- Developed and orchestrated SOAP web services that provided 100% of the backend support for IVR platforms, enhancing automation and customer service efficiency.
- Directed the work of the client‑assigned development team, ensuring effective coordination, technical guidance, and consistent delivery of high‑quality solutions.
- Oversaw project tracking and reporting, generating weekly status reports to maintain visibility, manage risks, and support informed decision‑making.
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle · PL/SQL · SOAP Web Services · Oracle Application Server · Java · Java Enterprise Edition · Interactive Voice Response (IVR) · Leadership · Microsoft Project · ADF/JSF/Struts/JSP

positions.title: Java Programming Instructor

- Provided hands‑on instruction in Java, enterprise technologies, and web development to around 200 students, enabling them to acquire industry‑relevant skills and improve their employment opportunities despite not holding a formal degree.
- Successfully delivered the Training Program for Business Technologies on the Web – Specialty: Development of E‑Business Applications, covering Java programming, web frameworks, and practical development practices.
- Authored a detailed DB2 student manual, offering structured guidance on database fundamentals, SQL, and enterprise data management to enhance student learning outcomes.
- Supported the professional growth of adult learners by equipping them with the technical foundation required to join the workforce and pursue careers in software development.
